name: Beach
description: Beach word search puzzles gather sand, tide and shore English for adults and seniors — dune, boardwalk, shell, breeze, towel, crab and calm harbor-edge words — without resort brands or licensed seaside characters. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays coastal and unhurried: foam, pier, cooler, barefoot and cliff vocabulary many summer readers already know. This hub pairs well with Ocean and Swimming when you want a longer waterfront session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as easy as a late-tide walk.
